THE LAWYER BEHIND THE TRACKER

Eric A. Hudson

Partner · Arambula Terrazas PLLC · Austin, Texas

Eric Hudson is a litigation partner at Arambula Terrazas PLLC with nearly two decades of experience in commercial litigation, constitutional disputes, injunctions, and appeals. He represents clients in state and federal courts and arbitration, including matters involving religious institutions and governmental action.

Before entering private practice, Eric served as a senior government litigator, handling complex constitutional, election, and public-law disputes. His practice combines trial advocacy with experience before the Texas Supreme Court, the Fifth Circuit, and the United States Supreme Court.

Religious liberty work

Eric represents individuals and institutions in disputes over the freedom to practice their faith and the right to equal treatment by government. His work includes challenges involving access to public education programs, land use, and state regulatory enforcement.

Eric served as counsel of record for the Legal Insurrection Foundation in Mahmoud v. Taylor, a U.S. Supreme Court case about religious exercise in public schools. He filed an amicus brief in support of the petitioners.

In coverage of an education case, Eric told The Texas Tribune and ProPublica, “Religious liberty is not a temporary pass issued after a lawsuit.” His work on disputes involving state investigations and land use has also been covered by KERA News and the Houston Chronicle. Texas Monthly’s October investigation examined the state’s securities case.

Eric also represents the East Plano Islamic Center (EPIC) in its federal lawsuit against the Texas Funeral Service Commission, a case concerning the right to carry out religious funeral rites. KERA News covered the case in an article republished by Texas Public Radio.
